 [UPDATED R3]. Prediction, H2H of Taylor Fritz’s draw vs Fils, Alcaraz, Ruud, Shelton to win the Paris
 Paris draw preview with H2H - Taylor Fritz may need to oust Arthur Fils, Carlos Alcaraz, Casper Ruud, Ben Shelton to conquer the competition in the Rolex Paris Masters.
 By Tennis Tonic - 5 November 2026 
 Taylor Fritz is 4 wins away to conquer the title in Paris. Fritz has defeated Benjamin Bonzi 3-6 6-3 6-4 and Alex Molcan 6-7 6 7-5 7-6 5 to reach the 3 rd round where he will face Arthur Fils .
 Draw prediction with head to head records
 This is Taylor Fritz’s projected draw alongsidehispresumable opponents in Rolex Paris Masters. Taylor has a unfavourable record (5-13) against the plausible opponents.

 Arthur Fils has a 41-15 win-loss record in 2026, 6-4 on indoor hard courts. In connection to the previous 7 years, Fils has a 57-41 record on indoor hard courts ( Click here to see full career record). The French player will try to keep a positive momentum since he is on a 10 matches winning streak.
 His best achievement of the season was conquering the competition in Barcelona where he overcame Andrey Rublev in the final 6-2 7-6(2), and in Cincinnati where he overcame Frances Tiafoe in the final 6-3 1-6 6-0.
 Last year in Rolex Paris Masters the French player didn’t compete in this event.

 His most significant result of this year was winning the competition at the Australian Open where he beat Novak Djokovic in the final 2-6 6-2 6-3 7-5, in Doha where he defeated Arthur Fils in the final 6-2 6-1, in Tokyo where he defeated Jiri Lehecka in the final 7-6(4) 6-4, and in Vienna where he defeated Alex De Minaur in the final 6-1 6-4.
 Last year in Rolex Paris Masters the Spaniard was defeated by Cameron Norrie in the 2 nd round 4-6 6-3 6-4 .
